part.text: We need to write a file game.js to the working directory. Must read any existing context? There's no existing game.js. Use write tool with content and path absolute. Path should be absolute: /tmp/.../game.js . Use write.

The `game.js` file has been created in the workspace. It targets the canvas element with `id="game"` and implements a simple obstacle‑avoidance game. The script sets up the canvas, handles player movement, spawns moving obstacles, detects collisions, tracks the score, and displays a “Game Over” screen when the player collides. You can now include this script in the HTML page that contains the `<canvas id="game"></canvas>` element.
